Both Anthropic and OpenAI have new initiatives to help enterprises deploy AI agents within their organizations. This is a trend that’s early but going to get very big fast.

As agents enter knowledge work beyond coding, there is very real work to upgrade IT systems, get agents the context they need, modernize the workflows to work with agents, figure out the human-agent relationship in the workflow, drive adoption and do change management, and much more. 

While AI models have an incredible amount of capability packed into them, there’s no shortcut to getting that intelligence applied to a business process in a stable way. This is creating tons of opportunities across the market for new jobs and firms, and the labs are equally recognizing the criticality here.

2026-05-07 AI Builders Digest

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🚀 BIG STORY · 大事件
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**Anthropic x SpaceX: Claude Moves to Colossus**

Anthropic announced a partnership with SpaceX to access their **Colossus supercluster** — one of the world's largest GPU clusters. As a result, Claude.ai is immediately **doubling 5-hour usage limits** and winding back peak-hour restrictions. Alex Albert (@alexalbert__) put it simply: "More chips, more Claude." Aaron Levie (Box CEO) added: "SpaceX as a vertically integrated AI compute company makes an insane amount of sense."

**Anthropic × SpaceX：Claude 搬进 Colossus**

Anthropic 宣布与 SpaceX 达成合作，接入其 **Colossus 超算集群**——全球最大的 GPU 集群之一。随即，Claude.ai **5小时用量上限翻倍**，高峰期限流也随之取消。Alex Albert 一句话总结："算力更多，Claude 更强。" Box CEO Aaron Levie 补充："SpaceX 作为垂直整合的 AI 算力公司，逻辑上完全说得通。"

---

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🤖 PLATFORM · 平台更新
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**Claude Managed Agents: Dreaming, Outcomes & Orchestration**

Anthropic shipped a significant update to Managed Agents on the Claude Platform. Three new capabilities:

1. **Dreaming** — a scheduled process that reviews past agent sessions, extracts patterns, and curates memories so agents self-improve over time. Like sleep consolidating memories, but for AI.
2. **Outcomes** — you write a rubric describing "what good looks like"; a separate grader evaluates agent output and the agent self-corrects until it passes. In testing, this improved task success by up to **+10 points**, with **+8.4% on .docx** and **+10.1% on .pptx** generation.
3. **Multiagent Orchestration** — a lead agent breaks complex jobs into pieces and delegates each to a specialist agent with its own model, prompt, and tools. Webhooks notify you when done.

**Claude Managed Agents：做梦、结果评估与多智能体编排**

Anthropic 对 Claude 平台 Managed Agents 进行了重大更新，推出三项新能力：

1. **Dreaming（做梦）** — 定期回顾历史会话、提炼规律、整理记忆，让 Agent 随时间自我进化。就像睡眠巩固记忆，只不过主角是 AI。
2. **Outcomes（结果评估）** — 你写一份"好的标准"，独立评分器对照打分，Agent 持续自我修正直到达标。测试中任务成功率提升最高 **+10 点**，文档生成提升 **+8.4%（docx）/ +10.1%（pptx）**。
3. **多 Agent 编排** — 主 Agent 把复杂任务拆解并分配给各专家 Agent，每个 Agent 有独立的模型、Prompt 和工具。完成后通过 Webhook 通知你。

---

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎙️ PODCAST · 播客
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**AI & I (Every): Why We Switched From Claude Code to Codex**
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IDSAMqip6ms

Dan Shipper (@danshipper) and the Every team discuss one of the most honest takes on the current agent war: **Codex three months ago was trash. Now it's a daily driver.**

The core insight: Anthropic proved that a great *coding* agent is implicitly a great *general-purpose knowledge work* agent — if it can write software autonomously, it can do anything. OpenAI saw this and executed a hard pivot on Codex. Now Dan uses it for writing, recruiting, deep engineering, even inbox zero — pulling from Gmail, Slack, Notion, and Stripe. The framing: we're in the era of the **agent management interface as the new OS**.

**AI & I（Every）：我们为什么从 Claude Code 切换到 Codex**
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IDSAMqip6ms

Dan Shipper 和 Every 团队带来了对当前 Agent 大战最坦诚的判断：**Codex 三个月前是垃圾，现在是每天必开。**

核心洞察：Anthropic 证明了——优秀的*编程* Agent 本质上就是优秀的*通用知识工作* Agent。能自主写代码，就能处理任何知识工作。OpenAI 看到 Claude Code 的势头后对 Codex 来了次硬转型。现在 Dan 用 Codex 写作、招聘、做工程、保持收件箱清零，同时接入 Gmail、Slack、Notion、Stripe。核心判断：我们已进入 **Agent 管理界面即新操作系统**的时代。

---

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💡 SIGNAL · 值得关注
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**Developer Tools Have a Messaging Problem** — @zarazhangrui

"Lots of developer tools are having a missed opportunity. Their product is now essentially useful to anyone who has access to an agent, not just professional developers. But their messaging & marketing still only talks to developers."

The audience has quietly expanded. The messaging hasn't caught up.

**开发者工具的定位危机** — @zarazhangrui

"很多开发者工具正在错失机会。他们的产品现在本质上对任何能用 Agent 的人都有价值，而不只是专业开发者。但他们的宣传和营销却还在只跟开发者说话。"

受众已悄然扩大，定位却还没跟上。

---

**Just-in-Time Software is Here** — @garrytan

Garry Tan declared "just in time software is here" — the shift from pre-built apps to code generated on demand for a specific task, then discarded. Also: GBrain benchmarked **8.3x faster** than a competitor on a specific corpus; hosted GStack is now the fastest way to spin up new products.

**即用即生成软件时代到来** — @garrytan

Garry Tan 宣告"即时软件时代已到"——从预装应用转向按需生成、用完即弃的代码。同时：GBrain 在特定语料上基准测试比对手**快 8.3 倍**；GStack 托管版是现在启动新产品最快的方式。

---

**AI Agents Can Now Schedule Meetings for You** — @petergyang

"Q: Can two AI agents schedule a meeting for their humans? A: Yep 😅"

Peter Yang shared a screenshot of two AI agents autonomously negotiating a calendar slot on behalf of their respective humans. A small moment, but a signal of what's becoming mundane.

**AI Agent 已能替你约会议** — @petergyang

"问：两个 AI Agent 能替各自的主人约一个会吗？答：可以 😅"

Peter Yang 分享了截图：两个 AI Agent 自主协商出了一个日历时间段。小事一桩，却是正在变成日常的信号。

---

**Cursor's Design Philosophy** — @ryolu_

"We design Cursor to be legible, customizable, and deeply under your control. See less when you need clarity. See more when you want depth."

The tool should shrink and expand based on what *you* need, not impose a fixed view.

**Cursor 的设计哲学** — @ryolu_

"我们把 Cursor 设计成清晰可读、高度可配置、深度可控。需要专注时少显示，需要深入时多展示。"

工具应该随你的需求收缩或展开，而不是强塞给你一个固定视图。
